## How a golfer turned a 10-year-old idea into an App Store app


Keith McGonigle had no coding background. With Thunkable’s AI, he built FOREcast, a golf weather app now downloaded by golfers around the world.


### At a glance


- **Builder:** Keith McGonigle, hobbyist
- **App:** FOREcast: Golf Weather App
- **App Store rating:** 5 stars
- **Time to a working app:** 1 week
- **Coding background:** None beyond WordPress
- **Before Thunkable:** 2 to 3 other app builders


### The idea: score the weather for golf


75 degrees, sunny and no wind earns a 10. A 20-degree morning earns a 0. Keith wanted a fun, social way to build excitement for his annual golf trip with friends, instead of trading weather texts.


### The challenge: a simple idea behind a high barrier


For about a decade, coding stood in the way. Every three to five years, Keith checked what app-building tools could do.


Some were too technical and asked him to learn an entire interface first. Others were too rigid, with a handful of drag-and-drop options or APIs that wouldn’t connect. He tried two or three platforms before landing on Thunkable.


### The turning point: usable from the first prompt


Keith typed a paragraph describing a weather forecast built around golf. Where other tools had returned a generic weather app, Thunkable’s AI returned a first mock-up that already looked like FOREcast.


“The first mock-up was already more in line with what I was thinking, and probably better than I could have imagined.” Keith McGonigle, Creator, FOREcast


### Building with AI that shows its work


Thunkable’s AI proposed each change and showed Keith what the screen would look like before he kept it. When a color needed changing, he asked. When an element looked off, he typed “fix it,” and the AI fixed it.


For precise tweaks, like making a box a little bigger, he edited the code directly without starting over. When he hit a snag registering an API key for his weather data, the Thunkable team took it offline and fixed it for him.


> “It shows you what it’s proposing and what it looks like, and you decide whether to change it or keep it. That made every step very easy.”


#### How Keith built FOREcast


- **Describe:** A paragraph on what the app should do.
- **Review:** AI shows each proposed change first.
- **Refine:** Ask for fixes, or edit the code directly.
- **Publish:** Ship it to the App Store.


### Results: from side project to international downloads


FOREcast was usable within about a week, followed by polishing and new features. Keith published it to the App Store as a personal project. It now holds a 5-star rating, and messages arrive from golfers he has never met.


- **1 week** to a working app
- **5 stars** on the App Store
- **Global** users in the UK and beyond


“I wouldn’t ever be able to do it without AI. It just wouldn’t be possible. This changed everything for me.” Keith McGonigle, Creator, FOREcast


### What’s next: built for real users


International users have asked for Celsius and km/h support and a clearer edit button. Because Keith put the work in upfront, the app needs little upkeep, and updates now happen mainly when users ask for something.


### Why it worked: no textbook required


- **A strong start.** One paragraph produced a first draft built around his idea, not a generic template.
- **Control at every step.** He reviewed each AI change, asked for fixes in plain words, and edited code when he wanted precision.
- **Help when it counted.** When an API key wouldn’t register, the Thunkable team resolved it for him.


> “Whether you’re a novice or technical, Thunkable makes things easier and more digestible. Whether you’re a hobbyist or looking for something for your business, it’s all doable with Thunkable.”
